parameters.query:
SELECT 
  t.id AS ticket_id,
  t.ticket_code,
  t.status,
  t.priority,
  COALESCE(t.category, t.intent, 'DEFAULT') AS category,
  t.due_at,
  t.created_at,
  t.updated_at,
  t.first_response_at,
  t.assignee_id,
  t.customer_id,
  t.department_id,
  COALESCE(t.last_alert_level, 0) AS last_alert_level,
  t.sla_breached,
  c.full_name AS customer_name,
  c.email AS customer_email,
  COALESCE(c.telegram_id, '7919420845') AS customer_telegram_id,
  s.full_name AS assignee_name,
  s.email AS assignee_email,
  COALESCE(s.telegram_chat_id, '7919420845') AS assignee_telegram_id,
  s.current_load AS assignee_current_load,
  COALESCE(sr.resolution_minutes, sr_def.resolution_minutes, 1440) AS sla_resolution_minutes,
  COALESCE(sr.first_response_minutes, sr_def.first_response_minutes, 60) AS sla_first_response_minutes,
  COALESCE(sr.category, sr_def.category, 'DEFAULT') AS matched_sla_category
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN staff s ON t.assignee_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN sla_rules sr ON (sr.category = COALESCE(t.category, t.intent) AND sr.priority = t.priority)
LEFT JOIN sla_rules sr_def ON (sr_def.category = 'DEFAULT' AND sr_def.priority = t.priority)
WHERE t.status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'RESOLVED')
ORDER BY t.created_at ASC;
